slides.title: A ticket for every fault **was the fault**
slides.scene: Two friendly retro cartoon robots, one orange and one silver, stand side by side in the centre of a small office that is drowning in an avalanche of paper tickets pouring out of a printer; the orange robot frantically staples tickets, the silver robot calmly holds up one single neatly folded ticket like a waiter presenting the bill. The two robots are the only characters. No phone, no mobile phone character, no mascot. Funny, bright.

items.text: tickets opened in one week. 36 closed
open, because nobody measured fill rate against drain rate
tickets from one 25-minute outage that had already ended
of open error tickets were one job's failures, filed twice
